title: ModDB page
description: moddb/<modid>/page.json: the editable fields of a mod's page on mods.vintagestory.at, as written by `vsdev moddb pull` (and ModDbCli's `moddb pull`).

modid.description: The modid from modinfo.json; also the folder name.

moddbId.description: Numeric id of the page on the mod database; null while the mod is unpublished.

moddbPageId.description: Optional. The id in https://mods.vintagestory.at/show/mod/<id> (the API calls it assetid). Set it for a draft page so `vsdev moddb` can read the draft from its HTML page.

name.description: Display title of the page on the mod database.

side.description: Where the mod runs: on both client and server, the client only, or the server only.

type.description: Kind of listing on the mod database: a game mod, an external tool, or something else.

homepageurl.description: Project homepage link shown on the page, e.g. a forum thread.

sourcecodeurl.description: Link to the source code repository.

trailervideourl.description: Link to a trailer or demo video.

issuetrackerurl.description: Link to where bugs and requests are reported.

wikiurl.description: Link to documentation or a wiki.

logo.description: Logo file on the page as logo.<extension> (the site's hashed CDN name is not stored); null when the page has no logo.

screenshots.description: File names of the page's screenshots, in the order the site shows them.

link.description: A URL starting with http:// or https:// ; the site returns an empty string or null when the link is unset.
